description: Curated seed spec for public DriveThruRPG catalog search and authenticated library downloads.

tools.name: auth-key_create-token-from-application-key
tools.description: Exchange a DriveThruRPG Library App Application Key for API tokens. Required: applicationKey. Returns the new AuthToken.

tools.name: categories_get-category
tools.description: Get public category details. Required: categoryId. Returns array of JsonApiItem.

tools.name: categories_list
tools.description: List public categories. Optional: page (default: 1), pageSize (default: 20). Returns array of JsonApiItem.

tools.name: filters_get
tools.description: Get public filter details. Required: filterId. Returns array of JsonApiItem.

tools.name: filters_list
tools.description: List public filters. Optional: page (default: 1), pageSize (default: 20). Returns array of JsonApiItem.

tools.name: order-products_list-library-products
tools.description: List authenticated user's purchased library products. Optional: getChecksum (default: 1), getFilters (default: 0), page (default: 1) (plus 3 more). Returns array of LibraryProduct.

tools.name: order-products_check_download
tools.description: Poll for a prepared purchased file download URL. Required: orderProductId, index. Optional: siteId (default: 10), getChecksums (default: 0). Returns the DownloadStatus.

params.name: siteId
params.description: DriveThruRPG site id. The public Library App uses 10.

params.name: index
params.description: File index from the owned product's files array.

tools.name: order-products_prepare_download
tools.description: Prepare a purchased file download URL. Required: orderProductId, index. Optional: siteId (default: 10), getChecksums (default: 0). Returns the DownloadStatus.

params.name: siteId
params.description: DriveThruRPG site id. The public Library App uses 10.

params.name: index
params.description: File index from the owned product's files array.

tools.name: products_get
tools.description: Get public product details. Required: productId. Returns array of JsonApiItem.

tools.name: products_search
tools.description: Search and list public DriveThruRPG products. Optional: page (default: 1), pageSize (default: 20), keyword (plus 2 more). Returns array of JsonApiItem.

params.name: publisherId
params.description: Restrict results to a publisher id.

tools.name: publishers_get
tools.description: Get public publisher details. Required: publisherId. Returns array of JsonApiItem.

tools.name: reviews_list
tools.description: List public reviews, optionally for a product. Optional: page (default: 1), pageSize (default: 20), productId. Returns array of JsonApiItem.

params.name: productId
params.description: Product id to filter reviews by.

tools.name: search-ahead_search_ahead
tools.description: Search ahead across products, publishers, categories, and filters. Required: keyword. Optional: pageSize (default: 20). Returns array of JsonApiItem.

tools.name: special-offers_list
tools.description: List active public special offers. Optional: page (default: 1), pageSize (default: 20). Returns array of JsonApiItem.
